tools.name: Tools
tools.hint: Which agent capabilities are exposed to the AI

zh.name: 工具
zh.hint: 提供给 AI 的智能体能力

enabled_tools.name: Enabled Tools
enabled_tools.hint: Select which tools to expose to the AI. Deselect to disable. manage_background_exec is enabled together with exec.

zh.name: 启用的工具
zh.hint: 选择要提供给 AI 的工具，取消选择即可禁用对应工具；manage_background_exec 随 exec 一同启用

file_access.name: File Access
file_access.hint: Who may use the file tools, and which extra paths they may reach

zh.name: 文件访问
zh.hint: 谁可以使用文件工具，以及可以访问哪些额外路径

permission_mode.name: Session Permission Mode
permission_mode.hint: allow_list: only the sessions in the list may use the file tools. deny_list: every session except the listed ones may.

zh.name: 会话权限模式
zh.hint: allow_list：仅名单内的会话可以使用文件工具；deny_list：除名单内的会话外都可以使用

session_list.name: Sessions
session_list.hint: Pick sessions from the list, or type one as <adapter_name>:<gm/dm>:<session_id>. The permission mode decides whether this list allows or denies.

zh.name: 会话名单
zh.hint: 从列表中一键选择会话，或手动输入 `<adapter_name>:<gm/dm>:<session_id>`；该名单是白名单还是黑名单由会话权限模式决定

extra_read_paths.name: Extra Read Paths
extra_read_paths.hint: Additional allowed path prefixes for read_file, list_files, grep and search_files

zh.name: 额外允许读取的路径
zh.hint: read_file、list_files、grep 和 search_files 额外允许的路径前缀

extra_write_paths.name: Extra Write Paths
extra_write_paths.hint: Additional allowed path prefixes for write_file and edit_file

zh.name: 额外允许写入的路径
zh.hint: write_file 和 edit_file 额外允许的路径前缀

exec_access.name: Command Execution
exec_access.hint: Who may run shell commands, and under which limits

zh.name: 命令执行
zh.hint: 谁可以执行命令，以及执行限制

permission_mode.name: Session Permission Mode
permission_mode.hint: allow_list: only the sessions in the list may run shell commands. deny_list: every session except the listed ones may.

zh.name: 会话权限模式
zh.hint: allow_list：仅名单内的会话可以执行命令；deny_list：除名单内的会话外都可以执行

session_list.name: Sessions
session_list.hint: Pick sessions from the list, or type one as <adapter_name>:<gm/dm>:<session_id>. The permission mode decides whether this list allows or denies.

zh.name: 会话名单
zh.hint: 从列表中一键选择会话，或手动输入 `<adapter_name>:<gm/dm>:<session_id>`；该名单是白名单还是黑名单由会话权限模式决定

command_deny_list.name: Command Deny List
command_deny_list.hint: Commands that may never run, regardless of the session permission

zh.name: 命令黑名单
zh.hint: 无论会话权限如何都禁止执行的命令

timeout.name: Exec Timeout
timeout.hint: Maximum runtime in seconds for commands without background mode.

zh.name: 前台命令超时
zh.hint: 未启用后台模式的命令最大运行时间，单位为秒。

background_timeout.name: Background Exec Timeout
background_timeout.hint: Maximum total runtime in seconds for commands in background mode.

zh.name: 后台命令超时
zh.hint: 启用后台模式的命令最大总运行时间，单位为秒。

background_wait_seconds.name: Background Exec Wait Time
background_wait_seconds.hint: How long to wait in seconds for a background command to finish before returning a task ID.

zh.name: 后台命令等待时长
zh.hint: 后台命令开始后等待结果的时长；超过该时长将返回任务 ID，单位为秒。
